askAssistant: Ask assistant to prescreen and score
confirmAdjustedInvalid: Enter an integer from 0 to 100, or leave blank to keep the original AI score.
confirmRevisionConflict: This score was changed by someone else. Reload and confirm again.
noCandidatesHint: Add candidates to this screening, then prescreen and score them with the assistant.
noScreeningHint: Create a screening here. Saved screenings are restored automatically.
title: Resume Screening
assistantRequest: Please screen and score screening {{screeningId}}. List candidates with resume_list_candidates, read each saved JD and resume with resume_get_candidate, then prescreen and score unconfirmed candidates. Leave final decisions to the human in the workbench.
assistantFailed: Could not send to the assistant. Retry from this workbench.
assistantFailedWithReason: Could not send to the assistant: {{reason}}
assistantSent: Scoring request sent. Follow progress in chat, then refresh this list for results.
noMatchesHint: Clear the search to see all candidates in this screening.
scoreDialogHint: Suggestions use the original AI score and prescreen rules. Final decisions are confirmed by a human.
scoreAdjustedSummary: Original AI score {{ai}} → after human adjustment {{score}}
skillsSeparatorHint: Separate skills with commas, Chinese list separators, or new lines. Blank entries and duplicates are removed.
editCriteriaHint: All fields can be edited before adding a candidate. Adding a candidate locks the job and scoring criteria.
editCriteriaLocked: Candidates have been added. You can edit the title. Create a new screening to change the job or scoring criteria and preserve historical evidence.
editFailed: Changes were not saved. Your input is preserved. Check the connection and retry.
editConflict: Another page changed this screening. Your input is preserved. Copy anything you need, close the dialog, refresh, and edit again.
editCriteriaChanged: Candidate intake has started, so criteria are locked. Your input is preserved. Close and refresh, or create a new screening.
skillInputPlaceholder: Type a skill and press Enter, e.g. Spring Boot
skillInputHint: Press Enter or comma to add tags; paste several skills. Duplicates are removed. Limit: {{limit}}.
skillDuplicate: This skill already exists and was not added again.

resumeEvidenceHint: Paste the resume or describe employment and project evidence. Years, degree and tags support rule checks; the five dimensions also need specific experience below. AI must not invent missing facts.
resumePlaceholder: Fictional example: Java backend developer, 2021–2025, responsible for order APIs. Used Spring Boot and MySQL in a transaction project. Include actual dates, responsibilities, personal contributions and supported outcomes. Leave absent credentials or experience blank.
resumeLength: {{length}} / 20000 characters; provide at least 30 characters of actual evidence. An empty outline is not experience evidence.
evidenceHint_experience: Relevant roles, dates, responsibilities and ownership.
evidenceHint_skills: Where each skill was used and the problem it solved.
evidenceHint_project_relevance: Project domain, personal contribution and supported results.
evidenceHint_stability: Employment start and end dates; do not infer missing history.
evidenceHint_bonus: Supported certificates, open source or patents; leave blank if absent.
candidateEditHint: Provide verifiable evidence before asking AI to score.
candidateViewHint: Review current material, scoring snapshots and past results.
candidateChangeWarning: Changes make previous scores and human decisions stale. They are preserved; re-score and review the updated material.
candidateSaved: Resume saved. Re-score and review the updated evidence.
candidateLoadFailed: Could not load the resume. Retry.
candidateSaveFailed: Resume not saved. Your input is preserved; check and retry.
candidateConflict: Another page changed this resume. Your input is preserved. Copy anything needed, close and reload.
staleEvidenceHint: Material changed. Old scores and decisions are preserved but are not current results. Re-score and review again.
unverifiedEvidenceHint: This historical score has no saved evidence snapshot, so its reasons cannot be verified against the current resume. Read the material and re-score when needed.
historyHint: Only scores replaced by re-scoring or invalidated by resume edits appear here. View the current result in Score details in the candidate list.
snapshotHint: Material saved with this score, for checking its reasons. It may differ from the currently edited resume.
historyEmpty: No past scores yet. Re-scoring preserves the previous scores and human decisions here.
candidateSectionHint: Read the material, select who to score, then review AI suggestions.
selectionHint: Select candidates for batch scoring or use each row's Score action. Up to 20 per request.
scoringSelectedRequest: Process only this explicit selection. Screening {{screeningId}}, scoring task {{taskId}}, candidate IDs: {{candidateIds}}. Read, prescreen and save each score using this task. Do not enumerate or score other candidates. State missing evidence; never invent employers, dates, metrics or credentials. Humans confirm in the workbench.
scorePrepareFailed: Could not create the selected scoring task. Nothing was sent to the assistant. Refresh and retry.
reevaluateHint: Your selection includes human decisions. Continuing calls the model again, may consume quota, and may produce different scores. Previous scores and decisions remain in history; new results require another review. Canceling does not start scoring.
rescoreHint: Your selection includes existing scores. Continuing calls the model again for the selected candidates, may consume quota, and may produce different scores. Existing scores remain in history; new results require human review. Canceling does not start scoring.
screeningListHint: Organize resumes and assessments by role. Open a screening to add, score and review candidates.
screeningDetailFailed: Could not load screening details. The list is preserved. Retry.
screeningFilterHint: Adjust the title, role keywords or status filter.
backgroundRefreshFailed: Could not update the list. The current content is preserved. Retry.
confirmAdjustedHint: Enter an integer from 0 to 100. Leave blank and save to clear the manual adjustment and restore the original AI score.
fieldTitleLimit: Screening title must be at most 200 characters.
fieldJobLimit: Job title must be at most 200 characters.
fieldJdLimit: Job description must be at most 20000 characters.
fieldYearsInvalid: Minimum experience must be an integer from 0 to 50.
fieldSkillsRequired: Add at least one required skill.
